title: Word-level Annotation of GDPR Transparency Compliance in Privacy Policies using Large Language Models

prompt.location: Appendix B.2 (passage-level classifier) and B.3 (annotator LLM), plus B.1 detector and B.4 reviewer prompts
prompt.note: Printed prompts are for the GDPR Art. 13/14 label scheme; the OPP-115 variant with a different label set is not printed.

claim.location: Table 3, block (1) Baseline, row gpt-4.1-nano, GDPR-Transparency-200 passage-level F1

data.source: GDPR-Transparency-200 (200 manually annotated app privacy policies, 25,260 annotations; release not stated in the text); OPP-115 public; annotator tool https://github.com/tomcory/privacy-policy-annotator

notes: gpt-4-turbo in live_ids appears only in the related-work table (prior studies). Soft gap: availability of the 200-policy ground truth; OPP-115 experiment (F1 0.737) uses an unprinted prompt variant. Span-level F1 0.484 uses a 0.7 similarity threshold.

resolution.plan: The GDPR-Transparency-200 corpus (200 policies, 25,260 annotations) has no release statement in the text; check the annotator repository for it. If present, run the Appendix B.3 annotator prompt standalone with gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 and compute passage-level F1 vs Table 3 (0.566). Fallback: the OPP-115 experiment (F1 0.737) uses public data, but its label-scheme prompt variant is also only in the repository; if neither is there the record becomes data_closed.
